text_block_list.text:
While walking on the way to a sports 
equipment store—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh? Hishi Ama-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yo, if it isn't Grass. What's up, you out 
shopping alone too?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I have an errand to run at this 
florist.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I barely ever set foot in flower 
shops. I don't even buy flowers for my 
pals' birthdays.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
They aren't a gift for anyone, actually~. 
I just came to look for some flowers for 
personal use.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heh, now I'm curious.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If you went out of your way to buy them, 
I'm guessing it's not for pressed flowers 
or something?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That sounds lovely as well, but today I 
need a few for flower arrangement.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ikebana! Man~, you really do have some 
refined hobbies.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it is one of my hobbies. It is 
wonderful for calming one's mind as well~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know. Would you like to join me, 
Hishi Ama-senpai~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Flower arrangement?! Me?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As they say, you never know until you 
try. Come along, let us do it together~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat...

Grass Wonder began explaining each and 
every flower displayed in the storefront 
to Hishi Amazon.

As she spoke so fondly and carefully about 
the flowers, Grass Wonder appeared 
thoroughly relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that is the explanation, but any 
color or shape is perfectly fine~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that... I don't dislike 
flowers, but I don't know the first thing 
about 'em.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Whatever comes to mind is quite fine. Just 
follow your feelings♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...To me, ikebana is something that 
reflects the heart like a mirror.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
When one's mind is turbulent, no matter 
how you arrange them, it looks unsettled.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Conversely, when you are calm, they appear 
peaceful. The exact same flower can show 
entirely different expressions.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That is why it is perfect for when one 
wishes to reflect upon oneself~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What's that mean? Got something on your 
mind you need to reflect on?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Nothing in particular. It is merely a 
hobby, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you say so. But if anything's 
bugging you, I'm always here to listen. 
Don't hold back, alright?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm glad to hear that. You're 
serious to a fault, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Studying and training even on your days 
off... I was worried you might be pushing 
yourself into a corner.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No matter how dedicated I am, I wouldn't 
go that far~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...At least, not at present.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Did you say something?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No~. Truly, there is no need to worry~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have firmly learned that giving one's 
mind room to breathe also leads to greater 
growth♪
